notes: The likelihood columns sum to one per hidden state; values are declared expert assumptions, not fitted frequencies.
Retreat, efficiency loss, follow-discard and safety improvement form ONE joint tradeoff category to limit double counting.
Pressure changes the context prior, not an additional repeated likelihood factor.
No final win/loss or opponents concealed tiles enter any feature. Review uses at most the next 3 own decisions.
Sensitivity envelope is not a credible interval. Calibrated probability stays null until independent human labels are evaluated.
